name: live-control-classic
label: Control (Classic 30m)
profile: classic pair-merge, 30m wait, 75% emergency floor, no cap, no rider
desc: Tournament #925 baseline: 30m stranded wait, pair-merge only, no entry cap, no trailing rider, 75% emergency floor.
thesis: Baseline measuring performance when unhedged legs must wait for pair-merge or aged-out rescue.
hypothesis: Suffers from buying heavy favorites (>0.60) and capping winning single legs at 1-2c merge spread.

name: live-cap60-revert30m
label: Ceiling 60c (No Rider)
profile: 0.60 entry ceiling, classic pair-merge, 30m wait, no rider
desc: Enforces 0.60 entry ceiling to prevent favorite blowouts, classic pair-merge structure, 75% emergency floor.
thesis: Tests whether eliminating >0.60 entries alone eliminates blowout drawdowns without changing exit logic.
hypothesis: Cuts blowout losses (e.g. -$4.59 on 0.68 entries) while retaining stable pair-merge spreads.

name: live-rider-2c-cap60
label: Rider 2c + 75% Emergency
profile: 2c trailing rider, 0.60 entry ceiling, 30m wait, 75% floor
desc: Primary recommendation: 2c trailing peak stop, cancels resting hedge on uptick, 0.60 entry ceiling, 75% circuit floor.
thesis: When single leg moves in favor, uncapping the leg with a 2c trailing stop captures huge momentum swings.
hypothesis: Turns historical net loss (-$14.14) into positive net PnL (+$24.38) and cuts drawdown by 90%.

name: live-rider-30pct-stop
label: Rider 2c + 30% Hard Stop
profile: 2c trailing rider, 0.60 ceiling, 30% drawdown stop, 30m wait
desc: Calibrated pre-timeout stop: cuts losses at 30% drawdown before timeout and before 75% floor, with 2c trailing rider.
thesis: Data proves trades exceeding 30% drawdown have an 88.5% doom rate; stopping at 30% saves capital without clipping healthy reversions.
hypothesis: Prevents deep 50-75% bleedouts on doomed teams, cutting average loss per loser from 50c to ~15c.

name: live-rider-1c-cap60
label: Tight Rider 1c + Cap 60c
desc: Aggressive profit-lock: 1c trailing peak stop to bank rapid momentum spikes with minimal giveback.
thesis: Live sports book fluctuations reverse quickly; a tight 1c trailing stop locks in peak gains faster.
hypothesis: Higher win-rate and faster capital recycling, though may exit early on small retracements.

name: live-rider-underdog-50c
label: Pure Underdog Rider 50c
profile: 2c trailing rider, 0.50 underdog entry ceiling, 30m wait
desc: Strict underdog bias: max 0.50 entry price, 2c trailing rider. Only enters when odds are <= 50%.
thesis: Underdogs possess the highest asymmetric upside (e.g. 21c buying Delaney riding to 88c+).
hypothesis: Maximum ROI per dollar risked; complete immunity to favorite collapse traps.
